geometryValidation.notes: Targeted generation/import/exact regeneration, asset integrity, strict budgets and source/imported normals/winding/UVs pass. Each imported level passes 82 controls covering both flight surfaces, landing coverage, beneath-flight air and retained roof/cab. One focused CC0 policy test accepts the same exact photographer/photo dedication and rejects attribution-only license, wrong creator, wrong photo, restrictions or missing transfer review.

limitations: Qualla corpus searched first. New stair construction uses the inspected original 2013 Bernard Spragg photograph with the photographer’s explicit primary CC0 dedication. Prior private museum and attribution-licensed imagery is excluded; mapped operations/tower frame retained. Not a measured survey.

Two physical switchback flights, intermediate landing, upper-storey landing, stringers, support posts and railings follow the public-domain photograph. Flight widths, tread counts and 0/2/4 m levels are photographic estimates. The 2013 reference does not certify every detail of the later restoration.

Museum sources describe 158 ft tower height and 168 ft observation access differently. The recipe approximates a 48.2 m shaft/tank transition and 51.2 m upper deck; individual levels, cabin roof and antenna heights are estimates.

Orange/white restored exterior represents the modern tower, not the incomplete camouflage-era 1941 structure. Spiral tread count, hidden rear windows, rail subdivisions, doors and rooftop equipment are simplified.
Includes the attached operations building and small aerological cab. Hangars, museum aircraft, interiors, vegetation and other site structures are excluded.
Reference photographs are viewed for research and are not embedded or redistributed. Generalized map geometry and host terrain require review when using another elevation dataset.

identityMigration.basis: Identity-only rename; exact source/runtime/LOD/heightfield/capture bytes verified unchanged. Existing visual inspection findings retained. No new capture or changed geometry is claimed.

Primary dedication and exact reviewed Commons transfer both bound to creator/photo ID and original SHA-1/SHA-256; generic public-domain labels alone do not qualify.
